prompt: Use case identity-preserve. Create transparent game animation atlas of ONLY same broken singer reference: tall slender white moth with dark eyes, fine curved antennae, leaf head ornaments, frayed ivory wings and cream/green/rust dress, crimson scarf, little broken wooden lute. Exact ink/watercolor handpainted reference art and design. 4 columns x4 rows sixteen full body poses. HUGE EMPTY transparent gutters. Draw each character SMALL in center of equal cell, figure occupies inner60% height including antennae, full wings/lute/toes no crop or overlap. Same scale and right facing three-quarter, fixed relative foot baseline. Row1 four distinct breathing/blink idle frames, wings gently flex, scarf shifts. Rows2+3 eight sequential talking/singing loop frames, expressive mouth/head and free hand/lute plucking changes with natural joint/cloth deformation, not translations. Row4 two greeting bow/hand frames then two restful quiet/slightly seated poses. Preserve all costume details and lute silhouette. Transparent background, no scene, no shadows, no grid, no labels/numbers/words, no extra character.

qa.notes: Reviewed all 20 distinct standing and resting drawings, including the 4 new idle in-betweens. Original painted regions retain their original RGBA. Idle, greet and talk share the planted boot landmark; rest retains its own seated origin.
qa.ground_anchor: Standing actions use the midpoint of the boot extents in the bottom 14 canvas pixels (alpha >128, components of at least 110 pixels reaching the bottom 2px). This excludes trailing scarf and robe tips. Target x=174 on the original 320px canvas. Each new cell is aligned at the same foot baseline as the originals.

idle_inbetweens.reference: idle endpoints from motion_expanded.png in their original motion_manifest.json canvas positions
idle_inbetweens.prompt: Four full-body drawings of the same right-facing broken singer, in the identical sepia ink and muted watercolor style of the four reference cels. In reading order draw the half-pose from A to B, B to C, C to D, and D back to A. Preserve the slender ivory moth, bell-tipped antenna, crimson scarf, folded wing, boots, and broken lute. Follow the neighboring blink, head, scarf and wing angles. Keep feet planted on a common baseline. Transparent two-by-two sheet with clear gutters.
idle_inbetweens.packing: Remove subvisible speckles more than 2 source pixels from alpha >24, crop each cell and uniformly scale to the mean height of its two neighboring drawings. Pack with a 3px clear border.
idle_inbetweens.sequence: Alternate each original drawing with its newly drawn successor. The four-pose 0.8s idle cycle becomes eight poses at 10fps.
